summary.text: You cannot have both plans. You can upgrade to CareShield Life for higher and lifetime payouts.

details.heading: If you upgrade
details.body: Your ElderShield coverage will end when you join CareShield Life. An ElderShield Supplement plan you already have will not be affected.

example_phrasings: Can I join both CareShield Life and ElderShield to get double the protection?
Can I have both plans at the same time?
Will I get double protection from both plans?

sources.page_title: Can I join both CareShield Life and ElderShield to get double the protection?

quotes.text: You will not be able to be on both CareShield Life and ElderShield.
However, upgrading to CareShield Life will not affect your ElderShield Supplement plan if you already have one.
